keyword.zh: 电动50和柴油50混凝土泵的区别

title.zh: 电动50和柴油50混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: Both print 30 MPa and a Kawasaki 140. The electric row is 55 kW and 26 m³/h. The diesel row is 6105 / 99 kW and 30 m³/h.
description.zh: 两边都印 30 MPa 和川崎140。电动行是 55 kW、26 m³/h。柴油行是 6105 / 99 kW、30 m³/h。

h1.zh: 电动50和柴油50混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: Electric 50 and Diesel 50 are separate concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric 50 prints a 55 kW motor, 26 m³/h and three stone-distance rows. Diesel 50 prints engine 6105 / 99 kW, 30 m³/h and one distance pair, 150 m / 450 m. Both print 30 MPa, Kawasaki 140, a 0.4 m³ hopper and 3300 kg is not shared: Electric 50 prints 2800 kg and Diesel 50 prints 3300 kg.
directAnswer.zh: 电动50和柴油50是河北品锦机械在邢台的两台混凝土泵。电动50印 55 kW 电机、26 m³/h 和三行石子距离。柴油50印发动机 6105 / 99 kW、30 m³/h 和一组距离 150 m / 450 m。两边都印 30 MPa、川崎140 和料斗 0.4 m³。重量并不相同：电动50为 2800 kg，柴油50为 3300 kg。

heading.en: Where Electric 50 and Diesel 50 print different values
heading.zh: 电动50和柴油50哪些数值不同

body.en: Theoretical output: Electric 50 prints 26 m³/h; Diesel 50 prints 30 m³/h. Dimensions: Electric 50 prints 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm; Diesel 50 prints 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm. Main unit weight: Electric 50 prints 2800 kg; Diesel 50 prints 3300 kg. The same printed value on a shared label: Max. outlet pressure is 30 MPa on both pages; Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³ on both pages; Hydraulic pump is Kawasaki 140 on both pages. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 理论输送量：电动50印 26 m³/h；柴油50印 30 m³/h。外形尺寸：电动50印 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm；柴油50印 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm。整机重量：电动50印 2800 kg；柴油50印 3300 kg。同一标题下数值相同的有：最大出口压力两边都是 30 MPa；料斗容积两边都是 0.4 m³；液压泵两边都是 Kawasaki 140。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Electric 50 prints cells that Diesel 50 does not: Motor power 55 kW; Fine-stone conveying (H / V) 150 m / 350 m; 13 mm stone (H / V) 80 m / 240 m; 24 mm stone (H / V) 60 m / 180 m. Diesel 50 prints cells that Electric 50 does not: Diesel engine power 6105 / 99 kW; Pumping distance (H / V) 150 m / 450 m. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 电动50有、柴油50没有的行：电机功率 55 kW；细石输送（水平/垂直） 150 m / 350 m；13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 80 m / 240 m；24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 60 m / 180 m。柴油50有、电动50没有的行：柴油机功率 6105 / 99 kW；输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 450 m。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: Read the drive line before comparing the shared 30 MPa cell. Open /en/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/ for Electric 50 and /en/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 50. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 对照相同的 30 MPa 之前，先读动力行。看电动50请打开 /zh/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/，看柴油50请打开 /zh/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Electric 50 print the same theoretical output as Diesel 50?
question.zh: 电动50和柴油50的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 50 prints 26 m³/h. Diesel 50 prints 30 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动50印 26 m³/h。柴油50印 30 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 50 print the same dimensions as Diesel 50?
question.zh: 电动50和柴油50的外形尺寸一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 50 prints 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm. Diesel 50 prints 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动50印 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm。柴油50印 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 50 print the same main unit weight as Diesel 50?
question.zh: 电动50和柴油50的整机重量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 50 prints 2800 kg. Diesel 50 prints 3300 kg. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动50印 2800 kg。柴油50印 3300 kg。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is motor power missing on Diesel 50?
question.zh: 为什么柴油50没有电机功率？

answer.en: The Diesel 50 page does not print that label. Electric 50 prints 55 kW. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 柴油50这一页没有印这个标题。电动50印的是 55 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
